About

Second-year industrial engineering student at Delhi Technological University and solo founder of Aletheon AI. I work at the seam where rigorous systems thinking meets messy, high-stakes data — pharma, capital markets, and hardware.

I learn by building the hard version first, end to end and from first principles. Off the screen I play tennis at the national level and paint — both teach the part of engineering nobody puts on a slide: composure when the plan breaks, and knowing when something is finished.

Aletheon AI

An end-to-end pharmaceutical intelligence platform I built solo. It collects, cleans, and structures fragmented industry data — regulatory filings, clinical-trial registries, patents, market reports — into decision-ready insight. A multi-agent LLM system with retrieval-augmented generation routes each query through specialised agents for retrieval, synthesis, and cross-verification, grounding every output in source documents to cut hallucination.
